description: Neural voices for NVDA based on Sonata
changelog: First stable release of the maintenance fork. Adds NVDA 2026.1 compatibility (Python 3.13, 64-bit) by rebuilding the bundled gRPC, miniaudio, and cffi binaries. Fixes voice list URL handling, voice install regex for names containing digits, voice list refresh after a successful download, install-from-local-file UX and error messages, and adds a Visual C++ Redistributable pre-flight check.
